place.name: Kosciuszko Bridge
place.description: The Kosciuszko Bridge ( KOZ-ee-UUSK-oh, KOZH-ee-UUSH-koh), originally known as the Meeker Avenue Bridge, is a cable-stayed bridge over Newtown Creek in New York City, connecting Greenpoint in Brooklyn to Maspeth in Queens. The bridge consists of a pair of cable-stayed bridge spans: the eastbound span opened in April 2017, while the westbound span opened in August 2019.
